faq.question: What is PDR?
faq.answer: Paintless dent removal (or repair) takes out minor dents and dings without removing or touching the paint. It also handles creases and hail damage.

faq.question: How is it done?
faq.answer: A trained technician gently and patiently massages the dent out from behind the panel using specialized tools. Done right, it looks like the dent was never there.

faq.question: Does it work on fender benders?
faq.answer: Often, yes. It depends on where the damage is and the type of metal. If the damage is severe or there's damage under the body panel, a body shop is the better call, and you'll be told so.

faq.question: Will my dent come back?
faq.answer: No. Once a quality technician finishes the repair, the dent stays out.

faq.question: Do I need to bring my car anywhere?
faq.answer: Usually not. Most repairs happen wherever your vehicle is parked, anywhere in the DFW Metroplex. The exception is heavy hail damage: if the repair will take longer than about 8 hours, you may need to drop the vehicle off. You'll know which it is when you get your quote.
